body: GitHub #1130 item 5. No Ruby conformance suite exists (conformance/test-validity-v0 and mcp-test-validity-v0 cover JS and Go); ruby tests lack described_class, shared-example and spec/support cases. Depends on S1-S4.
title: GH #1130 S6: Ruby profile qualification fixtures and black-box suite in CI
